system.description:
A mechanical bow that trades rate of fire for punching power and needs little training to aim.

Negative Traits: Heavy, Slow

Concealability: None

Damage: Two lethal health levels

Availability: Resources x3, Uncommon

Ammunition: Bolts (dozen) - Resources x3, Uncommon

Rate: One shot per action, one action to reload

Special Ability: Destroy Shield, Armor-Piercing, Staking (if wooden-tipped), Two-Hand Requirement

Uses the Archery Ability for combat retests.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages), Rules, Systems and Drama
